id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

children.description: The children that are wrapped by the loader

loadingItems.description: List of items that are putting this component in a loading state.

options.description:
Configurations options for the {@link NodeDiagram} that are not expected to change
over the course of the lifetime of the component.

selectedNodes.description: The ids of nodes that are selected. If {@link #options#mulitSelectable} is true, there can be multiple entries.

selectedEdges.description: The ids of edges that are selected. If {@link #options#mulitSelectable} is true, there can be multiple entries.

nodeContextMenus.description:
Context Menus to show on a node. Can be specified as a static list of {@link UiSdlAction} or an
array of {@link UiSdlDataTransform} that accepts the target node and returns a list of
{@link UiSdlAction}s.
Note that {@link UiSdlAction#hiddenCondition} and {@link UiSdlAction#disabledCondition}
are both supported. Use the condition {@link UiSdlDataItemFieldCondition} to have conditional
behavior based off of the targeted node.
If using {@link UiSdlDataTransform}, the input will be an object of
{ target: <targetObject>, targetType: string enum('node', 'edge', 'diagram')} and is expected
to return `[UiSdlAction]`.

edgeContextMenus.description:
Context Menus to show on an edge. Can be specified as a static list of {@link UiSdlAction} or an
array of {@link UiSdlDataTransform} that accepts the target edge and returns a list of
{@link UiSdlAction}s.
Note that {@link UiSdlAction#hiddenCondition} and {@link UiSdlAction#disabledCondition}
are both supported. Use the condition {@link UiSdlDataItemFieldCondition} to have conditional
behavior based off of the targeted edge.
If using {@link UiSdlDataTransform}, the input will be an object of
{ target: <targetObject>, targetType: string enum('node', 'edge', 'diagram')} and is expected
to return `[UiSdlAction]`.

paneContextMenus.description:
Context Menus to show on diagram background/empty space (pane). Can be specified as a static list of
{@link UiSdlAction} or an array of {@link UiSdlDataTransform} that returns a list of
{@link UiSdlAction}s.
Note that {@link UiSdlAction#hiddenCondition} and {@link UiSdlAction#disabledCondition}
are both supported.
If using {@link UiSdlDataTransform}, the input will be an object of
{ target: <targetObject>, targetType: string enum('node', 'edge', 'diagram')} and is expected
to return `[UiSdlAction]`. For the diagram's case, the target object will simple be `{ id: <componentId>}`.

panels.description: Panels on top of the {@link NodeDiagram}

updateQueue.description: Internal queue to track what updates need to happen in the rendering layer.

generatedImports.description: Receive the generated imports from {@link NodeDiagram.ImportGenerator}
